design.continuation: Exact first-policy prefix; one intervention; fresh first-eligible continuation.
design.maintenance: Frozen shift first; refit nearest-neighbor and recalibrate threshold using identical shift40 labels, evaluate both frozen/adapted on shift48. Count source/config/prompt changes, parameters/exemplars, labels and provider calls. No claim about human maintenance hours or long-term effort.
design.model_response_reuse: One Jev and one Codex answer per identical frozen packet; cascade reuses these actions.
design.name: escalation-quality-v1
design.stop: Report incomplete on infrastructure/correctness failure. Never force positive routing. If calibration chooses never escalate, retain that result and evaluate the held-out negative outcome.
design.success: All outputs correct; held-out cascade gains over Jev exceed max(2%, observed paired noise), with consistent direction across both families, escalation <=25%, and no disadvantage beyond noise against nearest-neighbor. Stock improvement is a separate practical criterion.

maintenance.limitation: Automated within-family pressure extrapolation; no human maintenance time measured. Counts of stored examples and one threshold are not comparable measures of engineering effort.

manifest.objective: Minimize runtime of the resulting native ARM64 code, considering spill, reload and rematerialization costs. Use only this compiler feature snapshot. There are no measured candidate outcomes in this packet.

protocol_deviation: After one invalid Jev response, resume recalibrated iteration counts: calibrate-dot_product-32 sites used 136036 and 134391 iterations. All arms within each site used identical counts. Future runs persist per-case counts; this run retains the original measurements.
scope: Single-state interventions on six synthetic families; no general escalation or maintenance advantage established.

verdict.interpretation: Conditional single-decision synthetic screening; not general compiler performance or maintenance proof.
